items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I haven’t seen Herb Ellis in many, many years.

ctx.x: He probably could have. I have one CD with him and Herb Ellis called “Rhythm Willie” where he plays a little bit. It’s pretty nice.
He definitely, that was his thing. His stock in trade.
